ui.title: Deliveries
ui.reverseDescription: This brings the goods back into stock at their original cost and reverses the cost journal. The reservation is not restored.
ui.noOpenLines: Enter the quantity to deliver for each line. Leave a line empty to skip it.
ui.invalidQty: Check the quantities: each must be above zero and not exceed the open quantity.
ui.nothingToDeliver: Enter a quantity for at least one line.
